sections.label: TAFEP and Tripartite Standards
sections.summary: TAFEP handles complaints about unfair hiring and works with non-compliant companies, while tripartite partners will develop voluntary Tripartite Standards.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The Tripartite Alliance for Fair and Progressive Employment Practices (TAFEP) looks into complaints about unfair recruitment and hiring practices and works with non-compliant companies to improve their practices.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: To further encourage employers to adopt progressive workplace practices, the tripartite partners will develop a series of Tripartite Standards that companies can voluntarily adopt.

sections.label: Recruitment Practices Standard
sections.summary: Public sector agencies will lead in adopting the Recruitment Practices Standard, which requires informing shortlisted interviewed applicants of outcomes, but not all applicants.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: One of these Standards is on Recruitment Practices, and public sector agencies will take the lead in adopting the Standard when it is launched.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: One of the specifications in the Standard is for employers to inform all shortlisted applicants who attend their job interviews about the outcome.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: On the question of whether applicants should be notified even if they are not shortlisted for interviews, the tripartite partners assessed that it would place an onerous burden on some companies, particularly small and medium enterprises, which have not fully automated their recruitment processes to deal with the large volumes of online applicants.

sections.label: Blacklisting and work pass privileges
sections.summary: Companies unwilling to comply may be blacklisted, and their work pass privileges may be curtailed.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: For example, if the companies truly are unwilling to comply, in some instances, we may blacklist them.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: If we blacklist them, then their work pass privileges may be curtailed.

sections.label: Tripartite Standards as additional measure
sections.summary: Besides laws, tripartite guidelines and advisories, Tripartite Standards are introduced to make adherence to progressive workplace practices more attractive to employers.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: In addition to the laws which employers must comply with, we also have tripartite guidelines and, over and above that, there are tripartite advisories.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: We are introducing the Tripartite Standards as an additional measure to make the adherence to progressive workplace practices more attractive for the employers to do.
